blocks.x: Agentic AI & Hyperautomation applied to Power Generation & Grid. This page sets out the operating context, the delivery pattern we run, the services and platforms involved, and the outcomes we commit to.

Grid operators balance physics, markets and regulation in real time: forecasting under intermittency, substation reliability, flexibility orchestration and CIP-grade security. The telemetry-to-decision loop is the core competency of the transition era.

items: DER flexibility activation by phone/portal; markets underused.
Renewable/demand forecasts legacy; imbalance and curtailment climb.

blocks.x: The pattern composes Decision Intelligence Systems, Autonomous Workflow Orchestration, Digital Workforce & Multi-Agent Orchestration from the Agentic AI & Hyperautomation tower, wired into the unit's workflows (Forecasting and dispatch, Asset condition management, DER/flexibility orchestration) on Dataq Swarm and Dataq Nexus and Dataq Compass. Governance inherits the sector frame — NERC CIP among others — with evidence generated by the delivery itself.

items: See the work as it actually runs: event-log truth before you automate anything.

blocks.x: At industry level, the same pattern

At Energy & Utilities level this capability reads as: condition signals to cost-optimal maintenance windows with parts and crews (unplanned outage hours down 30-50%). The sub-industry page narrows it to the unit's workflows, regimes and KPIs.

Programs run on a fixed rhythm so progress is visible from week one. Weeks 1–2 lock the baseline: the current metric is measured with your team and signed before build starts. Weeks 3–8 deliver the pilot on bounded scope — one decision path, one workflow, one plant or one portfolio — with a control owner named on your side. Weeks 9–12 industrialize what worked: runbooks, monitoring, enablement and a measured delta against the signed baseline. Anything that misses its gate is stopped or redirected with a documented decision, not quietly extended.
